fields.label: Live apply
fields.description: Update open Zen windows right away. Without the Zen watcher from the README, a window opens for about two seconds. When off, or while a window is fullscreen, colours apply with the next Zen window.

fields.label: Zen profiles
fields.description: Leave empty to use the profiles Zen starts with. Otherwise, profile folders separated by commas, e.g. ~/.config/zen/abcd1234.Default (release).
